# Generated directory

`cargo xtask gen --golden` writes every file in `tests/golden/` and below it, except `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`. Don't edit one by hand; run the generator instead. On a merge conflict in one, take either side and run `cargo xtask gen --golden`. The Generated directories table in `docs/contributing/repo-layout.md` lists every generated path.
